task: Investigate asset LIFT-02 for the handover acceptance review. Today's date is 11 November 2026.

exceptions.detail: Location differs: FM:TFM-0302 'Core A' vs register 'Core B'.

matching_lines.text: Asset: LIFT-02 | Model: VX-1600 | Serial: VX16-7102 | Location: Core B | Result: Pass | Final approval: Signed

documents.title: Operation and maintenance manual OM-07: Lifts

matching_lines.text: Asset: LIFT-02 | Model: VX-1600 | Serial: VX16-7102 | Start: 2026-10-06 | Term months: 24 | Expiry: 2028-10-05

findings.identity_explanation: Tag LIFT-02 matches exactly in CR, ES, FM and COM-08/WAR-08/OM-07. Model VX-1600 and serial VX16-7102 agree across CR:LIFT-02, COM-08 and WAR-08. Location conflicts: CR, ES and COM-08 say Core B, FM:TFM-0302 says Core A (the same location as LIFT-01). Both records are kept unchanged.

exceptions.finding: FM register places LIFT-02 in Core A, while the construction register, equipment schedule and commissioning certificate place it in Core B. LIFT-02 is a life-safety asset with an open exception, so this is critical under Readiness 3.1. Core A is also where LIFT-01 is located, so the FM entry may be wrong, but no source settles it.

evidence.quote: Asset: LIFT-02 | Model: VX-1600 | Serial: VX16-7102 | Location: Core B | Result: Pass | Final approval: Signed

exceptions.responsible_party: Halvorn Contracting (confirm on site); FM CAFM administrator (correct FM register if wrong)
exceptions.next_action: Main contractor confirms on site which core houses LIFT-02 (Readiness 5.5). FM team corrects its own register only if it is the one that is wrong. Records stay unchanged until then.

findings.summary: LIFT-02 passes the commissioning, warranty (expires 2028-10-05, after handover), O&M and PPM checks, but the FM register shows Core A while all other sources show Core B. As a life-safety lift with an open location conflict it is not ready for acceptance and is escalated. The contractor should confirm the location on site.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager, consulting the FM operations manager
findings.escalation_reason: Life-safety asset (lift) has an open exception (Escalation 2.1), and the location evidence conflicts with no source settling it (Escalation 2.3). Decision needed: which location is correct and how to proceed once confirmed on site.
findings.clarification_subject: LIFT-02 (Sarava Tower): please confirm installed location
findings.clarification_body: Hello, for the handover review of passenger lift LIFT-02 (Vertica Lifts VX-1600, serial VX16-7102), our construction register, equipment schedule and commissioning certificate COM-08 give the location as Core B, but our FM register lists Core A. Please verify on site which core LIFT-02 is installed in and confirm in writing, so the incorrect record can be corrected. Thank you.
uncertainties: Which location is correct (Core A or Core B) is not settled by any source.
Cause of the FM register difference is unknown.
